central_boundary.build: golang:1.26-alpine (go.mod requires 1.26.10, unchanged); CGO_ENABLED=0; go build ./cmd/server/; runtime alpine:3.24

coverage.source_method: gh token invalid; both trees fetched from the unauthenticated Git trees API and both full source archives from codeload; every archive file re-hashed as a Git blob and matched to its tree entry with no missing or extra paths.
coverage.method: Substantive diff screened in full for new hosts/URLs, HTTP construction, exec/syscall, env, file writes, embed, linkname, unsafe, credential headers; network, credential, store and config-sync chains read in full. Translator/scheduler logic screened, not line-read.
coverage.outside_build: cmd/fetch_copilot_models and cmd/fetch_codex_models are separate mains not reachable from cmd/server; README/docs/examples outside build.

semantic_findings: New GitHub Copilot provider (operator opt-in via device login): GitHub OAuth device flow and token exchange only to github.com/api.github.com with redirects disabled; inference only to an allowlist of *.githubcopilot.com API hosts (TrustedAPI) checked before every request.
Config file handling: locked CAS writes (temp file + rename, 0600), config upload and server-id (local deployment UUID, returned only via authenticated management API).
Store backends: config sync refactored into config_mirror; git/object/postgres stores already persisted config at the baseline; git remote still only from operator GITSTORE_* settings.
Antigravity: model-probe backoff keyed by sha256 of the access token (not transmitted); hub manifest and loadCodeAssist endpoints unchanged from baseline.
unsafe use in conductor_execution.go only compares two interface headers for identity.
README sponsor links changed (fenno.ai, qiniu.com): documentation only.
No new exec, env reads beyond existing GITSTORE_*/DEPLOY, embeds or linkname in the build.

dependency_review.provenance: Every changed build-reachable module: old/new zips from proxy.golang.org, h1 recomputed equal to go.sum and sum.golang.org; reachable-package diffs screened.

limitations: Native plugins, external Home and Copilot service behaviour not newly approved; provenance:false unchanged.
